overloads.semanticRole: The WEB SEND FILE command sends, to the Web browser, the HTML page or the Web file stored in the document whose pathname you pass in htmlFile .

constraints: Only has an effect when called from a Web process; called from any other process type, it does nothing and returns no error.
Sets the OK system variable to 1 if the file exists and the send did not time out, otherwise 0.
4D looks for htmlFile relative to the Web root folder defined in the Database Settings, unless an absolute pathname is given; both POSIX and system pathname syntax are accepted.
